observations: Two photos show the same item from slightly different angles, standing upright against a doorway/wall on an outdoor tiled floor.
Item is a full-size electronic keyboard/synthesizer with black and white keys, a control panel with buttons, a rotary dial, and a small LCD-type display.
The entire unit is wrapped tightly in clear plastic film, obscuring surface detail and any printed brand/model text.
No power cable, adapter, stand, or sustain pedal is visible in either photo.
The display/screen appears dark, with no indication the unit is powered on in any shot.
A faint logo/text is visible on the body near the screen in photo 1 but is not legible enough to confirm a brand or model.
Watermark 'MARY OLUGBAMI' overlays both images; no other identifying marks are legible.

claims.evidence: No shipping label, origin marking, or import documentation visible in either photo; 'London used' is a common Nigerian market term that cannot be confirmed from images alone.
No audio or video provided; sound quality cannot be assessed from still photos.

risks.risk: Keyboard may not power on or may have non-functioning keys/buttons.
risks.proof: A video clip showing the unit powered on, with keys being pressed and sound audible.

risks.risk: Missing power adapter, which is essential for operation.
risks.proof: A photo of the adapter/cable included with the sale.
risks.if_unproven: priced as incomplete, adapter not included

risks.risk: Physical damage (cracks, broken keys, scratches) hidden under the plastic wrap.
risks.proof: Photos with the plastic wrap removed, showing the full body and keys unobstructed.
risks.if_unproven: priced at worst case assuming possible cosmetic/structural damage

risks.risk: Speaker or audio output may be faulty despite claim of 'super sounds'.
risks.proof: A video with volume audible, demonstrating built-in speaker output.
risks.if_unproven: priced as speaker condition unknown/worst case

risks.risk: Unknown brand/model means unknown feature set (number of voices, keys, MIDI, etc.) affecting value.
risks.proof: A clear, unwrapped photo of the brand/model label or back panel sticker.

proof_requests: Video of the keyboard powered on, playing keys with audible sound.
Clear photo of the brand/model nameplate with plastic wrap removed.
Photo of the power adapter/cable included.
Full-body photos with plastic wrap removed showing all sides for cosmetic condition.
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable by type as a used electronic keyboard, but functionality, completeness (adapter), and cosmetic condition under the wrap are unverified, so it must be priced at worst case pending further proof.
